raw.markdown:
If you mean **SERP (Search Engine Results Page) APIs**, my picks in 2026 are:

| API | Best for | Pricing | My take |
|---|---|---:|---|
| **SerpApi** | Best overall / widest coverage | From $25/mo | ⭐ **Best overall** |
| **DataForSEO** | High-volume SEO/rank tracking | From $0.60/1K SERPs | ⭐ **Best value at scale** |
| **Serper** | Simple Google Search API | Low-cost credits | ⭐ **Best for simple Google-only apps** |
| **SearchAPI** | Developers wanting multiple engines | Competitive | Good alternative |
| **Scrapingdog** | General scraping + SERP | Competitive | Good for broader scraping |

### 🏆 My recommendation

**Use SerpApi if you want the easiest, most capable option.** It supports a very broad range of search engines and Google SERP features, with structured results. Its current plans start at **$25/month for 1,000 searches**, with a 250-search free tier. 

**Use DataForSEO if you're doing serious volume.** Its standard SERP pricing is currently **$0.60 per 1,000 SERPs**, with pay-as-you-go billing and no monthly subscription; Live mode is $2/1,000. 

So, roughly:

- **AI agent / SaaS / easiest integration → SerpApi**
- **SEO rank tracker / millions of searches → DataForSEO**
- **Just Google results cheaply → Serper**
- **Need many unusual search engines → SerpApi**

If you tell me **how many searches/month** you need (e.g. 10K, 100K, 1M) and whether you need **Google Maps, Shopping, AI Overviews, Bing, or just organic results**, I can tell you which one is cheapest and best for your exact use case.
